<thought>Template 1914394 corresponds to the reaction C1=CC=CC=C1 + CC(=O)O → C1=CC=CC=C1C(=O)O. Applying this template to any molecule that contains a phenylacetic acid substructure will give the two precursors benzene and acetic acid. The required format is a list of lists of SMILES strings, so the answer is [['c1ccccc1', 'CC(=O)O']].</thought>
<final_answer>[['c1ccccc1', 'CC(=O)O']]</final_answer>
